description: Figure 3 is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating execution accuracy results for different logical synthesis modules on the BIRD-dev dataset across difficulty levels. The horizontal axis contains four categorical groups labeled (from left to right) “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total,” and the vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” on a linear scale with tick marks shown at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 (values extend slightly above 60 to accommodate the tallest bar). Each category group contains two adjacent bars identified by the legend at the top: NatSQL is shown in light blue and TA-SQL is shown in darker blue. The labeled bar values are, for Simple: NatSQL 60.21 and TA-SQL 63.14; for Moderate: NatSQL 39.64 and TA-SQL 48.60; for Challenging: NatSQL 32.32 and TA-SQL 36.11; and for Total: NatSQL 51.35 and TA-SQL 56.19. The bars are not presented as stacked, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the numeric value labels above each bar.
